description: This file defines constants, structures, and class declarations related to NGAP (Next Generation Application Protocol) common message handling in 3GPP TS ASN.1 specifications, including identifiers, private information element structures, and related methods.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice of private IE ID with methods to set and get the type, pack, unpack, and convert to JSON.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class representing a private IE field with an ID, criticality, and value, including pack, unpack, and JSON conversion methods.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for items in a private IE container, with ID, criticality, and value, and methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON conversion.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the current type of private_ie_id_c.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into a bit_ref buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes data from a cbit_ref buffer into the object.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON format.
